rules.note: Controller → service → repository. No exceptions for 'hot' endpoints.
The 28 existing copies are debt, not precedent; no new ones.
cancel-service's REST call to notification is on the fix list.
consign-price is an internal helper of consign; vocabulary overlaps by design.

rules.title: New REST controllers are named <Domain>Controller under <service>/controller
rules.statement: Every new class exposing endpoints lives in the controller package and ends with Controller, so the API surface can be listed by name.

rules.title: Gateway routes and service configuration need a ticket that names them
rules.statement: A change to ts-gateway-service or any application.yml is a deployment change; the ticket must mention it explicitly.

rules.title: No new synchronous dependencies from preserve-service
rules.statement: Booking (preserve) already calls 11 services in one request path. Until the saga refactor lands, no new REST dependency is added to preserve or preserve-other; new steps go through the queue.
